newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Markets quiet.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Markets quiet.

text.p: U.S. cash soymeal markets were quiet, with some buyer interest for prompt shipped product, soymeal dealers said.

Several dealers said soybean crushers are reluctant to price deferred sales amid doubts about their ability to supply it, plus they are optimistic deferred CBOT soymeal futures will rise and narrow the discount to nearby futures.
CBOT May soymeal traded late Tuesday morning at $277.80 per ton versus July at $273.00 and August at $263.00.
Poor crush margins has some crushers scaling back production, making them reluctant to price deferred sales.
